text: Chawal pakane se pehle unhein aadha ghanta pani mein bhigo dein. Is se chawal lambe aur khile khile bante hain aur jaldi gal jate hain.
Roti ka aata goondhne ke baad usay pandrah minute dhak kar rakh dein. Aaram karne se aata naram ho jata hai aur roti achi phoolti hai.
Daal mein tarka lagane ke liye ghee garam karein, phir zeera, lehsan aur sabit laal mirch daal kar sunehra hone tak bhunein.
Chai mein doodh daalne se pehle patti ko pani mein achi tarah ubaal lein. Is tarah chai ka rang gehra aur zaiqa tez aata hai.
Garmi ke mausam mein din bhar pani zyada peena chahiye. Pyaas na bhi lage to har ghante baad ek glass pani pee lein taake jism mein pani ki kami na ho.
Achi neend ke liye sone se ek ghanta pehle mobile aur tv band kar dein. Roz ek hi waqt par sona aur uthna neend ko behtar banata hai.
Rozana tees minute tez chalna dil ke liye faidemand hai. Subah ki sair se wazan bhi qaboo mein rehta hai aur mood acha hota hai.
Khana khane se pehle sabun se haath dhona bohat si beemariyon se bachata hai. Haath kam az kam bees second tak malne chahiye.
Mobile ki battery jaldi khatam ho rahi ho to screen ki roshni kam kar dein aur jo apps istemal nahi ho rahi unhein band kar dein.
Phone ki storage bhar jaye to purani tasveerein aur videos computer ya cloud par mehfooz kar ke phone se mita dein.
Mobile pani mein gir jaye to usay foran band kar dein aur charger na lagayein. Phone ko do din tak sookhi jagah par rakhein.
Naya sim lagane ke baad phone ko dobara chalu karein. Agar signal na aaye to settings mein ja kar network khud se talash karein.
Mazboot password mein bare aur chote huroof, hindse aur nishan shamil hone chahiye. Har account ke liye alag password rakhein.
Kisi anjaan number se aane wale link par click na karein. Dhokebaaz log aise paighamat se bank ki maloomat churate hain.
Apna OTP ya pin code kisi ko bhi na batayein, chahe wo khud ko bank ka mulazim hi kyun na kahe. Bank kabhi phone par code nahi mangta.
Public wifi par bank ka kaam ya online khareedari karne se bachein. Aise network par aap ki maloomat asani se chori ho sakti hain.
Imtihan ki tayyari ke liye rozana ka time table banayein. Mushkil mazameen ko subah ke waqt parhein jab dimagh taza hota hai.
Sabaq yaad karne ka behtareen tareeqa ye hai ke parhne ke baad kitab band kar ke khud ko suna kar dekhein.
Parhai ke dauran har pachees minute baad paanch minute ka waqfa lein. Musalsal baithne se tawajju kam ho jati hai.
Angrezi behtar karne ke liye rozana ek safha buland awaz mein parhein aur naye alfaaz ek copy mein likhte jayein.
Lambe safar par nikalne se pehle gaari ke tyre ki hawa, engine ka tel aur pani zaroor check kar lein.
Pahari ilaqon mein sardiyon mein jate waqt garam kapre, dastane aur mazboot joote saath rakhein kyun ke barf par phisalne ka khatra hota hai.
Train ka ticket safar se kai din pehle book karwa lein. Eid aur chuttiyon ke dinon mein seat milna mushkil ho jata hai.
Hawai safar mein dasti saman ka wazan aksar saat kilo tak rakhne ki ijazat hoti hai. Nokeeli cheezein aur bari botal jahaz mein le jana mana hai.
Har mahine tankhwah milte hi us ka kuch hissa alag kar ke bachat mein daal dein. Kharch karne ke baad bachane ki koshish aksar nakaam rehti hai.
Ghar ka budget banane ke liye mahine bhar ke tamam akhrajat ek copy mein likhein. Is se pata chalta hai ke paisa kahan zaya ho raha hai.
Bijli ka bill kam karne ke liye din mein pankhe aur batiyan bila zaroorat na chalayein aur purane bulb ki jagah LED lagayein.
Sauda salaf ki fehrist bana kar bazaar jayein. Fehrist ke baghair khareedari mein ghair zaroori cheezein bhi aa jati hain.
Gamle ke paudon ko pani subah ya shaam ke waqt dein. Dopahar ki tez dhoop mein pani dene se jarein kharab ho sakti hain.
Tamatar ka paudha lagane ke liye aisi jagah chunein jahan din mein kam az kam chay ghante dhoop aati ho.
Sabziyon ke chilke aur chai ki patti ko mitti mein daba kar ghar par khaad banayi ja sakti hai.
Gulab ke paude ki sookhi tehniyan sardiyon ke aakhir mein kaat dein taake bahar mein naye phool zyada aayein.
Cricket mein ek over chay gaindon ka hota hai. Agar bowler wide ya no ball kare to wo gaind dobara karwani parti hai.
Batsman us waqt LBW out hota hai jab gaind bat ke bajaye pehle taang par lage aur seedhi wicket ki taraf ja rahi ho.
T20 match mein har team bees over khelti hai, is liye batsman shuru se hi tez run banane ki koshish karte hain.
Test match paanch din tak chalta hai aur har team ko do baar batting ka mauqa milta hai.
Interview ke liye waqt se das minute pehle pohanchein aur saaf suthre, saada kapre pehnein.
CV ek ya do safhon se lambi nahi honi chahiye. Sab se pehle apni taleem aur tajurba likhein aur ghair zaroori tafseel nikaal dein.
Interview mein tankhwah ke sawal par bazaar ke hisaab se ek munasib had batayein aur apne tajurbe ka hawala dein.
Interview ke aakhir mein company ke baare mein ek do sawal zaroor poochein. Is se aap ki dilchaspi zahir hoti hai.
Barsaat ke mausam mein chhat ki naaliyan saaf rakhein taake pani jama na ho aur deewaron mein seelan na aaye.
Machharon se bachne ke liye ghar ke aas paas khara pani jama na hone dein aur shaam ko khirkiyan band rakhein.
Sardiyon mein gas heater chala kar sona khatarnak hai. Sone se pehle heater band karein aur kamre mein hawa ka rasta khula rakhein.
Kapron se chai ka daagh hatane ke liye foran thanda pani daalein, phir thora sa sirka laga kar dho lein.
Chote bachon ko sone se pehle kahani sunane se un ke alfaaz ka zakheera barhta hai aur kitabon se lagao paida hota hai.
Bachon ka screen time roz ek ghante tak mehdood rakhein aur khane ke waqt mobile ya tablet bilkul na dein.
Bache ko school ke pehle din ke liye tayyar karne ke liye chand din pehle se subah jaldi uthane ki aadat dalein.
Bachon ke lunch box mein phal, ubla anda aur ghar ki bani roti rakhein. Bazaari chips aur meethi cheezein kam dein.
